source: Project Madurai pmuni0624_eng, Kausalya Hart translation
selectionBasis: The next twenty-six consecutive complete printed Tiruvaymoli units after pasuram 3012, covering pasurams 3013 through 3298. Every boundary follows the numbered Project Madurai edition and the concluding Sadagopan verse; every selected unit contains eleven printed pasurams.
prohibitedShortcuts: Treat the English translation as the unmediated Tamil wording.
Treat a theological statement made by the poetic voice as an independently verified historical or empirical fact.
Infer a complete doctrine from one numbered unit.
Normalize every divine name to one context-free identifier.
Turn poetic illness, possession, healing, or ritual language into a clinical diagnosis or medical recommendation.
Present the units' religious polemics as neutral history, an objective ranking of traditions, or a description of present-day communities.
Republish the translation instead of paraphrasing bounded observations with a link to the source.
